en.description:
iGotchi brings the classic virtual pet experience to your wrist. Hatch an egg, name your pet, and care for it throughout its life — all from your Apple Watch.

Raise & Evolve
Your pet grows through 6 stages: Egg, Baby, Child, Teen, Adult, and Elder. How you care for it determines which adult form it becomes — a Star Pet, a Buddy Pet, or a Grumpy Pet.

Care for Your Pet
• Feed it meals and snacks to keep it happy and full
• Clean up after it
• Give it medicine when it gets sick
• Turn off the lights at bedtime
• Discipline it when it throws a tantrum

Play Mini-Games
Keep your pet entertained with 3 different mini-games: Catch the Beat, Find Me, and Rock Paper Scissors. Winning boosts your pet's happiness!

Track Your Progress
View detailed stats, check your care history, and celebrate milestones as your pet reaches 1 hour, 1 day, 3 days, and 1 week of age.

Smart Notifications
Get gentle reminders when your pet needs attention — whether it's hungry, sick, dirty, or just missing you.

Personalized
Each pet gets a unique color palette at every evolution. Set your own sleep schedule so your pet rests when you do.

Localized
Available in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, and Japanese.

No internet required. No ads. No in-app purchases. Just you and your pet.
en.subtitle: Feed, play, and evolve!
